payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the previous state of the art in the context of the WinoGrande Challenge, identifying RoBERTa as the model that was surpassed by T5.

claims.text: The previous state of the art in the WinoGrande Challenge was based on the RoBERTa model, which is an encoder-only transformer architecture.
T5-3B surpassed the previous state of the art by achieving a score of 0.7673 AUC, which is over five points higher than RoBERTa's performance.
